source_provenance.statement: Source provenance and version history are unavailable.

historical_results.statement: Historical evaluation results are unavailable and no historical strength claims are verified.

validation_status: This artifact is not a validated rules implementation and must not be treated as the target Tuppi ruleset.

artifacts.role: Interactive legacy emulator, agents, PIMC, scoring, analysis, and CLI
Legacy Tk LAN client for a missing host implementation

known_major_limitations: Rules, state mutation, agents, search, presentation, and analysis are coupled in one module.
The default behavior is not the intended or current tournament ruleset.
The legacy code uses one module-global random stream for dealing, search, hints, and analysis.
Agent observations and hands are mutable and not protected by an enforceable information boundary.
Several invalid configurations and invalid actions are silently normalized or replaced.
PIMC determinizations omit some public-information constraints, including inferred voids.
There is no native finite all-AI runner or structured result format.
There are no preserved datasets, trained models, experiment configurations, or historical results.
